_about: PharmacyDoctors single source of truth for prices, durations, hours and policies (V5.3, 2026-11-26). Server (api/_lib/pay.js), catalog (assets/catalog.js) and tests read this file. Change prices ONLY here and only with owner approval.

treatments.name: Rapid Hydration
treatments.en: Fluids and electrolytes for sun, heat and long travel days.
treatments.es: Líquidos y electrolitos para el sol, el calor y los días de viaje.

treatments.name: Hangover Rescue
treatments.en: Rehydration and vitamins after a late night. Any medicine only if a doctor approves it.
treatments.es: Rehidratación y vitaminas después de una fiesta. Cualquier medicamento, solo si un médico lo aprueba.

treatments.name: Myers Cocktail
treatments.en: The classic blend of vitamins and minerals, given as an IV.
treatments.es: La mezcla clásica de vitaminas y minerales, aplicada por vía intravenosa.

treatments.name: Immunity Armor
treatments.en: Fluids with vitamin C and zinc for run-down travel days. It does not prevent or treat infections.
treatments.es: Líquidos con vitamina C y zinc para días de viaje pesados. No previene ni trata infecciones.

treatments.name: Energy & B12
treatments.en: B vitamins and fluids for tiring travel days.
treatments.es: Vitaminas del complejo B y líquidos para días de viaje agotadores.

treatments.name: Performance & Recovery
treatments.en: Fluids, electrolytes and vitamins after golf, fishing, sport or a long hike.
treatments.es: Líquidos, electrolitos y vitaminas después de golf, pesca, deporte o caminatas.

treatments.name: Beauty Glow
treatments.en: Hydration and vitamins before a wedding, shoot or event.
treatments.es: Hidratación y vitaminas antes de una boda, sesión de fotos o evento.

treatments.name: NAD+
treatments.en: A slower infusion, only after a health review. Research on its benefits is still limited.
treatments.es: Una infusión más lenta, solo después de una valoración. La evidencia sobre sus beneficios aún es limitada.

hours.clinic: 9 AM–5 PM daily; other times by appointment
hours.requests: 24/7 by WhatsApp, phone or online — availability and arrival time confirmed before payment
hours.xrayProvider: Clínica San José, Paseo Marino S/N, col. Chamizal, San José del Cabo · Mon–Fri 8:30 AM–7:30 PM · Sat 8:30 AM–2:00 PM

policies.payment: Nothing is charged until availability is confirmed; then 100% of the confirmed price by secure card link (Stripe). No deposits.
policies.cancellation: Full refund if you cancel 24 hours or more before, or if we cancel. Less than 24 hours or no-show: reviewed by authorized staff in writing. Delivered services are not refundable.
policies.refundTiming: Refunds return to the original card in 5–10 business days, depending on the bank.
